# Command-line reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py. Do not edit by hand; run the script. -->

## `bidwright`

```text
usage: bidwright [-h]
                 {run,demo,record,stop,approve,resume,purge,matrix,research,ui,api,spans,review,phoenix}
                 ...

Bidwright: RFP to proposal.

positional arguments:
  {run,demo,record,stop,approve,resume,purge,matrix,research,ui,api,spans,review,phoenix}
    run                 run one RFP file or package folder live
    demo                replay the recorded development run, with no keys
    record              run live and record cassettes, on the host
    stop                ask a running run to stop when its current step ends
    approve             decide a run's solution gate
    resume              continue a run from its last checkpoint
    purge               delete a run and its cache entries, or expired runs
    matrix              run a matrix of rungs and repeats
    research            manage the research server
    ui                  start the local Streamlit UI on 127.0.0.1:8501
    api                 start the local FastAPI wrapper on 127.0.0.1:8001
    spans               manage recorded OpenTelemetry spans
    review              record verdicts on a run's records
    phoenix             annotate a run's Phoenix trace

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```

## `bidwright run`

```text
usage: bidwright run [-h] [--profile {free,local,paid}] [--baseline {b0,ex0}]
                     [--allow-non-corpus CONSENT] [--cache] [--second-pass | --no-second-pass]
                     [--until {verify,coverage,consolidate,brief,capability_map,solution_gate,render}]
                     [--research {off,pack,live}] [--auto-select] [--bid-policy FILE]
                     [--solution {oneshot,fixed,decide,assess,manifest}]
                     [--risk-mode {oneshot,fixed,agent}] [--reflect | --no-reflect]
                     [--outputs OUTPUTS] [--run-id RUN_ID]
                     file

positional arguments:
  file                  an RFP file, or a folder holding a package

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --profile {free,local,paid}
  --baseline {b0,ex0}
  --allow-non-corpus CONSENT
  --cache               answer repeated calls from the cache
  --second-pass, --no-second-pass
                        re-read OBLIGATION zones (S-13); config/limits.yaml sets the default
  --until {verify,coverage,consolidate,brief,capability_map,solution_gate,render}
                        the last node to run
  --research {off,pack,live}
                        config/research.yaml sets the default
  --auto-select         approve the top-ranked option at the gate, for evaluation; never a blocked
                        gate
  --bid-policy FILE     a bid policy, for the bid signal
  --solution {oneshot,fixed,decide,assess,manifest}
                        config/limits.yaml's switches set the default
  --risk-mode {oneshot,fixed,agent}
                        config/limits.yaml's switches set the default
  --reflect, --no-reflect
                        offer the gated reflect tool; config/limits.yaml's switches set the
                        default
  --outputs OUTPUTS
  --run-id RUN_ID       the run folder's name; the UI names the runs it starts
```

## `bidwright record`

```text
usage: bidwright record [-h] [--name NAME] [--profile {free,local,paid}]
                        [--until {verify,coverage,consolidate,brief,capability_map,solution_gate,render}]
                        [--research {off,pack,live}] [--fill] [--auto-select] [--bid-policy FILE]
                        [--solution {oneshot,fixed,decide,assess,manifest}]
                        [--risk-mode {oneshot,fixed,agent}] [--reflect | --no-reflect]
                        [--outputs OUTPUTS]
                        file

positional arguments:
  file                  an RFP file, or a folder holding a package

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --name NAME
  --profile {free,local,paid}
  --until {verify,coverage,consolidate,brief,capability_map,solution_gate,render}
                        the last node to run
  --research {off,pack,live}
                        config/research.yaml sets the default
  --fill                keep the recording, record only the calls it lacks, and drop the unused
                        ones
  --auto-select         approve the top-ranked option at the gate, for evaluation; never a blocked
                        gate
  --bid-policy FILE     a bid policy, for the bid signal
  --solution {oneshot,fixed,decide,assess,manifest}
                        config/limits.yaml's switches set the default
  --risk-mode {oneshot,fixed,agent}
                        config/limits.yaml's switches set the default
  --reflect, --no-reflect
                        offer the gated reflect tool; config/limits.yaml's switches set the
                        default
  --outputs OUTPUTS
```

## `bidwright approve`

```text
usage: bidwright approve [-h] --role ROLE [--option OPTION] [--edit EDIT] [--override REASON]
                         [--reject REASON]
                         run

positional arguments:
  run                a run id under outputs/, or a run folder

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --role ROLE        the approver's role, never a name
  --option OPTION    switch to another option, such as OPT-2
  --edit EDIT        a YAML list of {field, value}, or - for standard input
  --override REASON  pass a blocked gate, with the reason
  --reject REASON    reject the solution; the run ends
```

## `bidwright resume`

```text
usage: bidwright resume [-h] [--raise-budget PERCENT] [--profile {paid}] run

positional arguments:
  run                   a run id under outputs/, or a run folder

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --raise-budget PERCENT
                        raise each run limit by PERCENT of its configured value
  --profile {paid}      continue a free run that paused on its quota under the paid key
```

## `bidwright research pack`

```text
usage: bidwright research pack [-h] --domain DOMAIN --title TITLE --keyword KEYWORDS --select-for
                               SELECT_FOR (--run RUN | --notebook NOTEBOOK) [--job JOB]
                               [--topic TOPICS] [--leave-out LEAVE_OUT] [--profile {free,paid}]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --domain DOMAIN       the pack's id, such as local-government
  --title TITLE         the pack's title, for people
  --keyword KEYWORDS    words a brief's topics must hold for the pack to be selected; at least 2
  --select-for SELECT_FOR
                        a run, id or folder, whose brief topics must select the pack
  --run RUN             a finished run in research mode live, id or folder
  --notebook NOTEBOOK   the NotebookLM notebook that holds the job
  --job JOB             with --notebook: the research job's task id
  --topic TOPICS        with --notebook: a subject the job researched; at most 5
  --leave-out LEAVE_OUT
                        a source id, such as PS-005, to leave out with its excerpts, such as a
                        tender
  --profile {free,paid}
```

## `bidwright-eval`

```text
usage: bidwright-eval [-h] {score,gate,baseline,explain,report,hash-gold,phoenix,external} ...

`bidwright-eval`: score frozen runs against gold. It never changes a run.

bidwright-eval score <run_dir>       prints the scorecard and writes evals/results/runs/<run>/
bidwright-eval gate <run_dir> --baseline evals/baselines/<rfp>.json
                                     applies config/thresholds.yaml; exits 1 on a block
bidwright-eval baseline <run_dir>    writes the run's scores, with the gold hash they were
                                     scored against, to evals/baselines/<rfp>.json
bidwright-eval explain <run_dir> <gold_id>
                                     shows what happened to one gold item in the run
bidwright-eval report <matrix>       scores every run of outputs/matrices/<matrix>/ and
                                     writes evals/results/<matrix>/ with each rung's decision
bidwright-eval phoenix <run_dir>     scores the run and sends the scorecard's headline lines to
                                     its Phoenix trace as annotations (ADR-053)
bidwright-eval hash-gold             records the hashes of the gold files and of
                                     evals/hypotheses.yaml in evals/gold/MANIFEST.sha256
bidwright-eval external crackedpdfs --data <folder>
                                     runs guard's PDF scan on the CrackedPDFs test split,
                                     kept outside the repository, and writes only the scores
                                     to evals/results/external/crackedpdfs.md

positional arguments:
  {score,gate,baseline,explain,report,hash-gold,phoenix,external}
    score               score one run folder
    gate                gate one run folder against a committed baseline
    baseline            write a run's scores as the baseline
    explain             what happened to one gold item in a run
    report              score a matrix's runs and decide each rung
    hash-gold           freeze the current gold files' hashes
    phoenix             score a run and send its scores to its trace
    external            run one stage against a public benchmark

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```
